notes: Researched the SP (speakON) output variant, which Lab.gruppen sells as SKU "PLM 12K44 SP" (a "PLM 12K44 BP" variant also exists, identical except its 3 speakON connectors are replaced by 4 pairs of binding posts). Data combined from the manufacturer's own product Specs tab (labgruppen.com) and the official PLM+ Series Quick Start Guide PDF, which includes a labeled rear-panel diagram explicitly showing "PLM 12K44" on the chassis silkscreen — used to confirm exact port names/counts/connector types. Ethernet ports: the rear-panel silkscreen and manual read "SWITCHED 100/1000 Base-TX" with 1Gbps activity LEDs, so graded eth-1g; note the website's separate online spec table text states "Auto 10/100, Auto Uplink" for the same 2xRJ45 entry, which looks like a stale/inconsistent listing — the printed panel and manual (more specific to this SKU) were trusted over it. Dante audio (8 in x 8 out) rides over the same two etherCON connectors as the Lake Controller/DLM control connection, not a separate port. No USB, RS232, or GPIO ports are present on this model. Rack size 2U (88mm), weight 16.5 kg (36 lbs), depth 424mm rail-to-rear (498mm including front support).
